short_description: Infarm - Indoor Urban Farming GmbH is a Berlin-headquartered German vertical-farming and controlled-environment agriculture company founded in 2013 by Erez Galonska, Guy Galonska and Osnat Michaeli that deploys modular in-store and warehouse-scale growing units for leafy greens, herbs and produce. In December 2021 Infarm closed a Series D funding round that took its post-money valuation above one billion US dollars, giving it European unicorn status. From 2022 onward Infarm shifted its operating model toward larger centralised growing centres and later scaled back its European retail-facing operations to concentrate on markets where the unit economics were most favourable.
